name: Dropdown Table Widget
description: SAC Table Widget with inline dropdown cell selection from data binding dimensions

styleConfig.description: JSON string with style configuration from styling panel

dropdownOptions.description: JSON array defining options per column: [{dimensionKey, options:[]}]

dropdownDimensions.description: JSON array of dimension feed IDs to render as dropdown e.g. ["dimensions_1","dimensions_2"]

lastAddMemberRequest.description: JSON string do último pedido de criação de membro

deleteMemberId.description: ID do membro a ser excluído — preenchido ao clicar em Excluir membro

deleteMemberDimensionId.description: ID real da dimensão SAC do membro a ser excluído

newMemberId.description: ID do novo membro digitado no modal Adicionar membro

newMemberDescription.description: Descrição do novo membro digitada no modal Adicionar membro

newMemberParentId.description: ParentId (hierarquia) digitado no modal Adicionar membro

changedValue.description: Valor alterado/usado na ultima edicao de medida ou dropdown

memberTechnicalMap.description: JSON string mapping dimension names to member descriptions and their technical IDs. Example: {"RESPONSABILIDADE": {"SAPORE": "[RESPONSABILIDADE].[H1].[&SAPORE]"}}.  Populated from metadata during data binding.

pendingChanges.description: Delimited string with pending changes. Format: dimensionId§technicalMemberId§value§measureId###... (§ separates fields, ### separates records). Technical IDs are resolved from _memberTechnicalMap cache during _selectValue().

measureChangeMeasureId.description: ID da medida alterada (ex: CUSTO, QUANTIDADE)

measureChangeAddrStr.description: Endereço das dimensões da linha alterada no formato DIM=ID;...

dimensionFilterId.description: ID da dimensão a filtrar — preenchido por setDimensionFilter

dimensionFilterMembers.description: IDs dos membros a filtrar — preenchido por setDimensionFilter

selectedCellData.description: JSON string of the last selected cell {row, dimensionId, memberId, memberLabel}

headerColor.description: Background color of the header row

dropdownHighlightColor.description: Highlight color for selected dropdown item

rowHeight.description: Height of each row in pixels

colWidth.description: Column width: auto or pixel value

getMeasureChangeValue.description: Retorna o valor da medida alterada.

getChangedValue.description: Retorna o valor alterado/usado na ultima edicao de medida ou dropdown.

getPendingChanges.description: Retorna o buffer de alteracoes pendentes.

clearPendingChanges.description: Limpa o buffer de alteracoes pendentes.

getMeasureChangeMeasureId.description: Retorna o ID da medida alterada.

getMeasureChangeAddrStr.description: Retorna o endereço das dimensões da linha alterada no formato DIM=ID;...

getLastAddMemberRequest.description: Retorna o último payload de criação de membro como JSON string.

getDeleteMemberId.description: Retorna o ID completo do membro a ser excluído (formato SAC).

getDeleteMemberIdClean.description: Retorna o ID limpo do membro a ser excluído (sem prefixo de dimensão/hierarquia).

getDeleteMemberDimensionId.description: Retorna o ID real da dimensão SAC do membro a ser excluído.

getNewMemberId.description: Retorna o ID do novo membro digitado no modal.

getNewMemberDescription.description: Retorna a descrição do novo membro digitada no modal.

getNewMemberParentId.description: Retorna o parentId (hierarquia) digitado no modal.

setDropdownOptions.description: Define dropdown options per column. Pass array: [{dimensionKey:'dimensions_1', options:['Mensal','Bimestral',...]}]

setDropdownDimensions.description: Define which dimension feed IDs render as dropdown e.g. ["dimensions_1","dimensions_2"]

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: JSON array of dimension feed IDs

getDropdownDimensions.description: Get dropdown dimension config as JSON string

getSelectedCellData.description: Get the last selected cell data as JSON string

getActiveFilters.description: Get all active dropdown filters as JSON string

setDimensionFilter.description: Aplica filtro de dimensão. Ex: setDimensionFilter("Date", "[Date].[YM].&[202606]")

removeDimensionFilter.description: Remove filtro de dimensão do binding.

setRowValues.description: Define valores pré-selecionados por linha. Formato: {contaId: 'contaId|periodoId|fonteId|respId'}

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: JSON string do mapeamento de valores por linha

clearMeasureInput.description: Limpa o valor da celula de medida que foi alterada por ultimo.

getPreviousCellData.description: Retorna os dados da celula anteriormente selecionada antes da ultima troca de dropdown.

getOldRowAddrStr.description: Retorna o addrStr da linha antes da ultima troca de dropdown (usando rowValuesMap).

getNewRowAddrStr.description: Retorna o addrStr da linha apos a ultima troca de dropdown.

onMeasureChanged.description: Fired when a measure value is changed. Read via getMeasureChangeValue(), getMeasureChangeMeasureId(), getMeasureChangeAddrStr().

onDropdownChanged.description: Fired when a dropdown value is selected. Read selectedCellData for {row, dimensionId, memberId, memberLabel}.

onAddMemberRequested.description: Fired when user confirms 'Adicionar membro'. Detail: {dimensionId, dimensionName, newMemberId, newMemberDescription, parentId, rowIndex, contextMemberId, contextMemberLabel}. Connect to: PlanningModel_X.createMembers(dimensionName, [{id: newMemberId, description: newMemberDescription}])

onDeleteMemberRequested.description: Fired when user clicks 'Excluir membro'. Detail: {action:'excludeMember', dimensionId, dimensionName, memberId, memberLabel, rowIndex}. Connect to: PlanningModel_X.deleteMembers(dimensionName, [memberId])

onFilterMemberRequested.description: Fired when user clicks 'Filtrar membro' or 'Filtrar'. Detail: {action:'filterMember'|'filter', dimensionId, dimensionName, memberId, memberLabel, rowIndex}.

onExcludeRowRequested.description: Fired when user clicks 'Excluir' (row exclusion). Detail: {action:'exclude', dimensionId, dimensionName, memberId, memberLabel, rowIndex}.

onSaveRequested.description: Fired when user clicks Salvar. Detail: array of {rowIndex, addrStr, measures, address} for changed rows only.

feeds.description: Dimensions — populate rows and dropdown option lists
Dimensions at child level — used to populate dropdown options
